# `planroom-models`

This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** `Transport` (live, record, replay), Jev codecs, the Claude gateway and session backends, retries, spend accounting, the live gate and the host allow-list.
- **May depend on:** `contract`, and its allow-list in `boundaries.toml`: `reqwest`, `rustls`, `tokio`, `sha2`, `serde`, `serde_json`, `thiserror` [DR-79].
- **Must not:** other workspace crates; any network call without `PLANROOM_LIVE_*` or a consented credential; treating an ambient proxy as a credential.
- **How to test it:** `jev_contract.rs` (both codecs over every fixture), `claude_decoders.rs`, `session_backend.rs`, `redact.rs`.

Read first, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#read-first-per-area):

- **Sections:** [Model adapters](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#model-adapters); [Spend guards](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#spend-guards); [What leaves the machine](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#what-leaves-the-machine).
- **Records:** [DR-18](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-18-claude-backends-the-gateway-and-the-sessions-model-through-the-mod), [DR-41](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-41-jev-adapter-and-pins), [DR-49](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-49-model-calls-are-opt-in-consented-and-redacted), [DR-65](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-65-cost-gates-that-can-fail), [DR-75](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-75-authority-stays-with-a-persons-own-action).
